recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a presentation-policy change to duplicate the Extension Pack root-extension warning on core profile pages.
issue_request: FHIR-17031 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked that Binary and Bundle stop listing "Extensions for all resources or elements" because neither resource allows root extensions or modifier extensions.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 277d844cf88efa4ddfb4d03eb3ab64c67fa4fb38, matching the Jira comment for svn revision 14351, by suppressing generic Profiles & Extensions page generation for resources whose root type was not DomainResource.
additional_context: Binary and Bundle are still active normative resources. Their StructureDefinitions derive from Resource rather than DomainResource and have no root extension or modifierExtension paths. Current CI profile pages no longer show the stale generic extension listing, while the Extension Pack pages now carry the precise warning that Binary and Bundle do not have root extensions but may have extensions on permitted child elements. Direct FHIR-17031 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because the authoritative model and current extension-listing surface already convey the required rule.

related_jiras.note: A nearby Published Parameters issue touched the same no-root-extension generator area, but it concerns Parameters and was not needed to decide Binary or Bundle.
